value.rationale: The exact logical collapse between finite generalized hexagons and octagons is a structural classification across natural finite incidence geometries with different diameter/girth, valid for both unequal degree parameters and without geometric symmetry. Fourteen exact ordered-pair types and a sharp rank-three versus rank-four quadrangle boundary identify the first logical visibility of higher gonality. This is more than a definition chase or numerical extrapolation and provides reusable finite-rank invariants for geometric model theory.
